My second full set inspired by works from Smash Daisaku : The Humiliating Final Days of an Exorcist / https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/77597074.

It's the first part of the set and features the intro of the three females and the the fate of the first one, the Ninja lady.
Second part is WIP. No estimation when that will be finished.

A Comic version will be done once the set is completed.

Hope you enjoy and don't forget to leave a comment if you like it, or find something you don't like.
